cuhk.policy_en: For 2026 entry, the best result in the same subject taken by a candidate in his/her three most recent attempts of the HKDSE examination will be used for calculation of the admission score. For some programmes, the admission scores of applicants seeking admission on the strength of results from more than one sitting of the HKDSE examination will be adjusted.
cuhk.source: Reference(2026)/CUHK/Arrangement-for-more-than-one-sitting-2026.pdf (penalty band VLM-verified from the table image; PDF text layer unreliable)

hku.policy_en: A penalty of 10% is applied to the RETAKE SUBJECT only for HKDSE repeaters.
hku.source: Reference(2026)/HKU/hku_raw_api.json → accordionHTML 'Consideration of HKDSE Previous / Combined Results & Penalty for HKDSE Repeaters'
